exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Machine)

source_english.description: Bicep Curl (Machine) is performed seated against a lever pad, curling the handles while the upper arms remain supported.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the upper arms rest flat on the pad and grip the handles with palms up.
Start with the elbows nearly straight and shoulders relaxed.
Curl the handles toward the shoulders without lifting the upper arms from the pad.
Pause at the top, then lower until the elbows are nearly straight.
form_cues: Keep upper arms on the pad.
Keep wrists neutral.
Move only at the elbows.
source_english.safety_note: Set the seat and pad height before loading the machine; use a weight you can lower smoothly.

source_english.description: Chin Up (Assisted) uses an underhand grip and a kneeling counterweight platform for a controlled vertical pull.
instructions: Grip the fixed bar underhand with hands about shoulder-width apart and begin with elbows straight.
Brace the trunk and pull the elbows toward the ribs until the chin clears the bar.
Pause without craning the neck.
Lower until the arms are straight, then reset.
form_cues: Keep ribs down.
Drive elbows toward the floor.
Keep legs quiet.
source_english.safety_note: Use a secure bar and enough assistance to control the full hang.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)

source_english.description: The inclined leverage-machine handles press forward from the upper chest and return under control.
instructions: Adjust the seat and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your elbows and lower the handles back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked over the elbows.
Brace the trunk and keep the shoulder blades controlled.
Use a smooth lower and press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a stable setup and stop before the shoulders or wrists lose controlled alignment.

source_english.description: Sit at the leg-extension machine and straighten one knee against the pad before lowering it and switching legs.
instructions: Sit on the leg-extension machine with the knee aligned to its pivot and one ankle behind the pad.
Hold the side handles and keep the other leg clear of the lever.
Extend the working knee until the lower leg is nearly horizontal.
Lower the pad until the knee is comfortably bent, then switch legs.
form_cues: Keep the trunk against support.
Track the elbows on the working path.
Stop short of a forced lockout.
source_english.safety_note: Use a secure setup and stop if alignment or control is lost.
